prompt:
Image 1 is the approved character for this game. KEEP ITS PROPORTIONS EXACTLY: a Q-style super-deformed chibi figure about two and a half heads tall, with an enormous head at roughly 45 percent of the figure height, huge round expressive eyes filling most of the face, a tiny nose and a small cheerful smile, short stubby limbs, oversized hands and boots, and the same very thick dark ink outline with flat 2-tone cel shading and one key light from the upper-left.

TASK: Redraw THE SAME LITTLE CHARACTER in a MEDIEVAL EUROPEAN setting. Change the costume and the world, not the proportions, not the pose, not the camera. Same fixed three-quarter view from above (camera about 55 degrees above the horizon), same neutral idle stance, feet together.

COSTUME - MEDIEVAL, HANDMADE, SLIGHTLY WORN: a hooded hooded cloak of coarse homespun wool in a deep heraldic blue, with an undyed cream linen lining showing at the hood opening and the hem, and a simple ochre border stripe. Under it a plain cream linen tunic. A wide brown leather belt with a brass buckle, a small leather pouch and a single iron key hanging from it. Soft brown leather boots with a folded cuff. On the left shoulder a small embroidered heraldic badge, a simple shield shape.

STAFF - MEDIEVAL: a rough hand-carved wooden quarterstaff, taller than the character, with twist-carved grooves and two iron bands. Its head is a rough-cut amber crystal held in a cage of twisted root and iron, glowing with warm candle-like amber light. NO modern or plastic parts.

MATERIALS: wool, linen, leather, hand-forged iron, rough wood, unpolished amber. Everything looks made by hand in a medieval village - sturdy, plain and a little battered. Nothing glossy, nothing synthetic, nothing shiny-modern.

PALETTE: deep heraldic blue, undyed cream linen, ochre and brass, warm brown leather, dark hand-forged iron, and the warm amber staff crystal as the single brightest accent. Earthy and warm, like an illuminated manuscript.

TECHNICAL OUTPUT: square, TRANSPARENT background (real alpha channel), single isolated figure, centred, small even margin on all four sides, whole body inside the frame including feet.

EXCLUDE: modern clothing, zips, buttons that look machine-made, plastic, neon, glowing cyan, sci-fi, robots, tall or realistic proportions, a small head, long legs, cast shadows on the ground, ground plane, scenery, props, other characters, text, labels, UI, frames, watermark, signature, cropped limbs.
